Answers that we believe must be heard. Frequently asked questions About 2% Salicylic Acid Face Wash Should I use a face wash with Salicylic Acid? If you're someone with normal, oily, combination and acne-prone skin, this Salicylic Acid face wash is perfect for you. Can you use Salicylic Acid Face wash every day? This face wash has 2% Salicylic Acid which is potent and safe to use every day. You can start using this twice a day. If you experience dryness, use it once a day until your skin adjusts to this formula. What does Salicylic Acid do to your face? Salicylic Acid is a potent BHA and an antibacterial agent. When applied to your face, it treats acne by exfoliating dead skin cells and deep cleansing pores. It also deep cleanses the skin by unclogging clogged pores. Does this Salicylic Acid face wash remove blackheads? Yes. This Salicylic Acid face wash is a potent BHA which deep cleanses and unclogs pores which helps reduce the appearance of blackheads. Does Salicylic Acid work on dark spots? No, this Salicylic Acid cleanser won't work on dark spots. If you're looking for a solution, we'd recommend going for ingredients like Vitamin C and Niacinamide. They have melanin reduction properties which help reduce pigmentation on your skin. Can Salicylic Acid cause pimples? Salicylic Acid is an antibacterial agent. It doesn't cause pimples but instead reduces acne formation. Can I use a Salicylic Acid face wash with Vitamin C? This this is a facewash that does not stay on the skin for long - you can use Vitamin C with it. Can I use Niacinamide after Salicylic Acid face wash? Yes. Salicylic Acid face wash pairs very well with Niacinamide. Salicylic Acid exfoliates skin gently and niacinamide helps reduce redness and pigmentation, improving skin texture. What are the side effects of Salicylic Acid? Salicylic Acid has no side effects on normal, oily, combination and acne-prone skin. If you are someone with dry skin, using Salicylic Acid might cause over drying of skin. Thus people with dry skin shouldn't be using this product. Should I use Salicylic Acid face wash in the morning or night? If you're someone with oily, combination and acne-prone skin, we'd prefer you to include this salicylic acid face wash in your AM and PM routine. If you experience dryness, use it once a day. Which is better foaming face wash or normal? It all depends on your preference. We'd suggest going to 2% Salicylic Acid Face Wash over 1% Salicylic Foaming Face Wash based on your skin type and acne. Is this Salicylic Acid face wash suitable for all skin types This Salicylic Acid Face Wash is suitable only for normal, oily, combination and acne-prone skin.
